title: The spacetime Penrose inequality under a quasi final state hypothesis
summary: Penrose's original heuristic for his eponymous spacetime inequality -- a conjectured lower bound on the ADM mass in terms of the area of a horizon cross-section -- relies on the black hole final state conjecture. In this paper we isolate a substantially weaker but precise late-time condition, which we call the quasi final state hypothesis and prove the spacetime Penrose inequality under this hypothesis.
